articles.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
articles.snippet: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

articles.title: Nvidia-led tech selloff weighs on crypto majors
articles.snippet: Only five of the top 100 cryptocurrencies by market value are up 1% or more over the past 24 hours. That is the state of the market today.

articles.title: Zcash developers want 20-second blocks just days after major speed upgrade
articles.snippet: Early data shows Zcash's orphan-block rate holding close to pre-upgrade levels despite blocks arriving three times faster, encouraging developers to push for another reduction.

articles.title: SpaceX proposes a $24 billion Texas supercomputer and a gas plant
articles.snippet: The $24 billion project, which includes an AI supercomputer in Texas with its own gas-fired power plant, is about 17 times the value of SpaceX's bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
articles.snippet: Stablecoin supply has barely grown this year, even as payments using the tokens surge. Circle's latest earnings offer another example of the divergence between dollars outstanding and activity on blockchain networks.
